answer: A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The trellis counter is kept in timber and ridge publishes each reset. An adversary as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 339 aliases cost 323 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
